title: Virtual Card Management: Tracking Virtual Card Transactions and Spending
summary: This document explains how to manage virtual cards by using real-time spending alerts, assigning card nicknames (e.g., “Team—Vendor—Purpose”) for transaction grouping in reports/searches, using recurring-use cards for subscriptions, and running a monthly reconciliation workflow (filter by nickname, review alert history for anomalies, compare recurring charges to expected schedules/amounts, then export and attach supporting documentation).
faqs: How do I enable and use real-time spending alerts to monitor virtual card approvals/declines?
What card-nickname naming convention should I use to organize transactions for reporting and searching?
How can I monitor recurring subscription spend using recurring-use virtual cards?
What is the monthly reconciliation workflow for virtual card transactions?
When reviewing monthly activity, how do I check alert history and recurring charges against expected schedules/amounts?
How do I export filtered transaction views and attach supporting documentation after reconciliation?
